<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="32" />
    <application
        android:allowBackup="true"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher"
        android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_launcher_round"
        android:label="Mindset"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@style/Theme.MaterialComponents.DayNight.NoActionBar">
        <activity android:name=".WidgetConfigActivity" android:exported="true" android:label="Mindset">
            <intent-filter> <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" /> <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" /> </intent-filter>
            <intent-filter> <action android:name="android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_CONFIGURE" /> </intent-filter>
        </activity>
        <receiver android:name=".SquarePhraseWidget" android:exported="true" android:label="Mindset (Cuadrado 2x2)">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_UPDATE" />
                <action android:name="com.synthesisco.frases.ACTION_MIDNIGHT_UPDATE" />
                <action android:name="com.synthesisco.frases.ACTION_REVEAL_PHRASE" />
            </intent-filter>
            <meta-data android:name="android.appwidget.provider" android:resource="@xml/widget_info_square" />
        </receiver>
        <receiver android:name=".RectanglePhraseWidget" android:exported="true" android:label="Mindset (Rectángulo 4x2)">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_UPDATE" />
                <action android:name="com.synthesisco.frases.ACTION_MIDNIGHT_UPDATE" />
                <action android:name="com.synthesisco.frases.ACTION_REVEAL_PHRASE" />
            </intent-filter>
            <meta-data android:name="android.appwidget.provider" android:resource="@xml/widget_info_rectangle" />
        </receiver>
        <receiver android:name=".BootReceiver" android:exported="true">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED" />
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.TIMEZONE_CHANGED" />
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.TIME_SET" />
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.WALLPAPER_CHANGED" />
            </intent-filter>
        </receiver>
    </application>
</manifest>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<RelativeLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:id="@+id/widget_root"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:padding="4dp">

    <ImageView
        android:id="@+id/widget_bg_image"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:scaleType="fitXY"
        android:src="@drawable/widget_glass_bg"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

    <Chronometer
        android:id="@+id/widget_countdown"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:layout_alignParentBottom="true"
        android:layout_centerHorizontal="true"
        android:layout_marginBottom="9dp"
        android:countDown="true"
        android:fontFamily="sans-serif-medium"
        android:letterSpacing="0.06"
        android:textColor="#D9FFFFFF"
        android:textSize="10.5sp"
        android:shadowColor="#B3000000"
        android:shadowDx="0"
        android:shadowDy="1"
        android:shadowRadius="4" />

    <ImageView
        android:id="@+id/widget_phrase_image"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:layout_above="@id/widget_countdown"
        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
        android:layout_marginStart="10dp"
        android:layout_marginEnd="10dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="2dp"
        android:scaleType="fitCenter"
        android:contentDescription="@null" />

</RelativeLayout>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="#08151C"
    android:fillViewport="true">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:gravity="center_horizontal"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:padding="18dp">

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Mindset"
            android:textColor="#F3A87E"
            android:textSize="20sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <FrameLayout
            android:id="@+id/preview_container"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="185dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
            android:background="#122C3B"
            android:padding="14dp">
            <include layout="@layout/widget_layout" />
        </FrameLayout>

        <!-- BARRA DE OPACIDAD Y DESENFOQUE -->
        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tv_opacity_label"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="14dp"
            android:text="Opacidad y Efecto Vidrio: 60%"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
            android:textSize="15sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <SeekBar
            android:id="@+id/seekbar_opacity"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
            android:max="100"
            android:progress="60" />

        <!-- MODO TAP TO REVEAL (PRENDER / APAGAR) -->
        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="14dp"
            android:text="Revelar Frase al Tocar (Tap to reveal diario)"
            android:textColor="#F3A87E"
            android:textSize="14sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:weightSum="2">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_reveal_on"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginEnd="4dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:backgroundTint="#F3A87E"
                android:text="Activado (Tap to reveal)"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#08151C"
                android:textSize="11.5sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_reveal_off"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginStart="4dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:backgroundTint="#1E2933"
                android:text="Desactivado (Siempre visible)"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="11.5sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <!-- 4 VALORES PARA EL GROSOR DE LA LETRA -->
        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="14dp"
            android:text="Grosor de la Letra (4 Valores)"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
            android:textSize="14sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:weightSum="4">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_weight_1"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginEnd="3dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:backgroundTint="#1E2933"
                android:padding="0dp"
                android:text="1. Fina"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="12sp" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_weight_2"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginHorizontal="3dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:backgroundTint="#F3A87E"
                android:padding="0dp"
                android:text="2. Media"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#08151C"
                android:textSize="12sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_weight_3"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginHorizontal="3dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:backgroundTint="#1E2933"
                android:padding="0dp"
                android:text="3. Gruesa"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="12sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_weight_4"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginStart="3dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:backgroundTint="#1E2933"
                android:padding="0dp"
                android:text="4. Extra"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="12sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <!-- COLOR DEL VIDRIO Y TEXTO: BLANCO O NEGRO -->
        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
            android:text="Color del Vidrio y del Texto"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
            android:textSize="14sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:weightSum="2">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_glass_white"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginEnd="4dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:backgroundTint="#F3A87E"
                android:text="Vidrio Blanco"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#08151C"
                android:textSize="12sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_glass_black"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginStart="4dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:backgroundTint="#1E2933"
                android:text="Vidrio Negro"
                android:textAllCaps="false"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="12sp"
                android:textStyle="bold" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="40dp"
            android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:weightSum="2">

            <Button
                android:id="@+id/btn_text_white"
                android:layout_width="0dp"
                android:layout_height="match_parent"
                android:layout_marginEnd="4dp"
                android:layout_weight="1"
                android:backgroundTint="#F3A87E"

package com.synthesisco.frases

import android.Manifest
import android.app.Activity
import android.appwidget.AppWidgetManager
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.content.res.ColorStateList
import android.graphics.Color
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.Chronometer
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.SeekBar
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class WidgetConfigActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    private var appWidgetId = AppWidgetManager.INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID
    private var currentOpacity = 60
    private var isBlackGlass = false
    private var isBlackText = false
    private var currentWeight = 2
    private var currentCropY = 48
    private var currentCropX = 50
    private var useBlur = true
    private var tapToReveal = true

    private lateinit var ivBg: ImageView
    private lateinit var ivPhrase: ImageView
    private lateinit var chronometer: Chronometer
    private lateinit var weightButtons: List<Button>
    private lateinit var btnGlassWhite: Button
    private lateinit var btnGlassBlack: Button
    private lateinit var btnTextWhite: Button
    private lateinit var btnTextBlack: Button
    private lateinit var btnPickWallpaper: Button
    private lateinit var btnClearWallpaper: Button
    private lateinit var btnRevealOn: Button
    private lateinit var btnRevealOff: Button

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setResult(Activity.RESULT_CANCELED)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_widget_config)

        appWidgetId = intent?.extras?.getInt(AppWidgetManager.EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID, AppWidgetManager.INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID)
            ?: AppWidgetManager.INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID

        val perm = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES else Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, perm) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, arrayOf(perm), 2002)
        }

        ivBg = findViewById(R.id.widget_bg_image)
        ivPhrase = findViewById(R.id.widget_phrase_image)
        chronometer = findViewById(R.id.widget_countdown)
        val tvOpacity = findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_opacity_label)
        val tvCropY = findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_crop_y_label)
        val tvCropX = findViewById<TextView>(R.id.tv_crop_x_label)
        val seekOpacity = findViewById<SeekBar>(R.id.seekbar_opacity)
        val seekCropY = findViewById<SeekBar>(R.id.seekbar_crop_y)
        val seekCropX = findViewById<SeekBar>(R.id.seekbar_crop_x)

        weightButtons = listOf(
            findViewById(R.id.btn_weight_1),
            findViewById(R.id.btn_weight_2),
            findViewById(R.id.btn_weight_3),
            findViewById(R.id.btn_weight_4)
        )
        btnGlassWhite = findViewById(R.id.btn_glass_white)
        btnGlassBlack = findViewById(R.id.btn_glass_black)
        btnTextWhite = findViewById(R.id.btn_text_white)
        btnTextBlack = findViewById(R.id.btn_text_black)
        btnPickWallpaper = findViewById(R.id.btn_pick_wallpaper)
        btnClearWallpaper = findViewById(R.id.btn_clear_wallpaper)
        btnRevealOn = findViewById(R.id.btn_reveal_on)
        btnRevealOff = findViewById(R.id.btn_reveal_off)

        currentOpacity = WidgetHelper.getOpacity(this, appWidgetId)
        isBlackGlass = WidgetHelper.isBlackGlass(this, appWidgetId)
        isBlackText = WidgetHelper.isBlackText(this, appWidgetId)
        currentWeight = WidgetHelper.getFontWeight(this, appWidgetId)
        currentCropY = WidgetHelper.getCropY(this, appWidgetId)
        currentCropX = WidgetHelper.getCropX(this, appWidgetId)
        useBlur = WidgetHelper.useWallpaperBlur(this, appWidgetId)
        tapToReveal = WidgetHelper.isTapToRevealEnabled(this, appWidgetId)

        seekOpacity.progress = currentOpacity
        seekCropY.progress = currentCropY
        seekCropX.progress = currentCropX
        tvOpacity.text = "Opacidad y Efecto Vidrio: $currentOpacity%"
        tvCropY.text = "Altura del widget en tu pantalla: $currentCropY%"
        tvCropX.text = "Posición horizontal en tu pantalla: $currentCropX%"

        chronometer.isCountDown = true
        chronometer.base = WidgetHelper.getMidnightElapsedRealtimeBase()
        chronometer.start()

        btnRevealOn.setOnClickListener {
            tapToReveal = true
            updateButtonsUI()
            refreshPreview()
        }

        btnRevealOff.setOnClickListener {
            tapToReveal = false
            updateButtonsUI()
            refreshPreview()
        }

        weightButtons.forEachIndexed { idx, btn ->
            btn.setOnClickListener {
                currentWeight = idx + 1
                updateButtonsUI()
                refreshPreview()
            }
        }

        btnGlassWhite.setOnClickListener { isBlackGlass = false; updateButtonsUI(); refreshPreview() }
        btnGlassBlack.setOnClickListener { isBlackGlass = true; updateButtonsUI(); refreshPreview() }
        btnTextWhite.setOnClickListener { isBlackText = false; updateButtonsUI(); refreshPreview() }
        btnTextBlack.setOnClickListener { isBlackText = true; updateButtonsUI(); refreshPreview() }

        seekOpacity.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(object : SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener {
            override fun onProgressChanged(s: SeekBar?, p: Int, f: Boolean) {
                currentOpacity = p
                tvOpacity.text = "Opacidad y Efecto Vidrio: $p%"
                refreshPreview()
            }
            override fun onStartTrackingTouch(s: SeekBar?) {}
            override fun onStopTrackingTouch(s: SeekBar?) {}
        })

        seekCropY.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(object : SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener {
            override fun onProgressChanged(s: SeekBar?, p: Int, f: Boolean) {
                currentCropY = p
                tvCropY.text = "Altura del widget en tu pantalla: $p%"
                refreshPreview()
            }
            override fun onStartTrackingTouch(s: SeekBar?) {}
            override fun onStopTrackingTouch(s: SeekBar?) {}
        })

        seekCropX.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(object : SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener {
            override fun onProgressChanged(s: SeekBar?, p: Int, f: Boolean) {
                currentCropX = p
                tvCropX.text = "Posición horizontal en tu pantalla: $p%"
                refreshPreview()
            }
            override fun onStartTrackingTouch(s: SeekBar?) {}
            override fun onStopTrackingTouch(s: SeekBar?) {}
        })

        btnPickWallpaper.setOnClickListener {
            useBlur = true
            updateButtonsUI()
            val pick = Intent(Intent.ACTION_GET_CONTENT).apply { type = "image/*"; addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE) }
            startActivityForResult(Intent.createChooser(pick, "Elige tu fondo de pantalla"), 1001)
        }

        btnClearWallpaper.setOnClickListener {
            useBlur = false
            WidgetHelper.clearCustomWallpaper(this)
            updateButtonsUI()
            refreshPreview()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Modo Cristal Puro Universal activado", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }

        findViewById<Button>(R.id.btn_save_widget).setOnClickListener {
            WidgetHelper.saveConfig(this, appWidgetId, currentOpacity, isBlackGlass, isBlackText, currentWeight, currentCropY, currentCropX, useBlur, tapToReveal)
            WidgetHelper.updateAllWidgets(this)
            WidgetHelper.scheduleMidnightUpdate(this)
            if (appWidgetId != AppWidgetManager.INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID) {
                setResult(Activity.RESULT_OK, Intent().putExtra(AppWidgetManager.EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID, appWidgetId))
            }
            finish()
        }

        updateButtonsUI()
        refreshPreview()
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode: Int, permissions: Array<out String>, grantResults: IntArray) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        refreshPreview()
    }

    private fun styleToggle(btn: Button, active: Boolean) {
        btn.backgroundTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(Color.parseColor(if (active) "#F3A87E" else "#1E2933"))
        btn.setTextColor(if (active) Color.parseColor("#08151C") else Color.WHITE)
    }

    private fun updateButtonsUI() {
        styleToggle(btnRevealOn, tapToReveal)
        styleToggle(btnRevealOff, !tapToReveal)
        weightButtons.forEachIndexed { idx, btn -> styleToggle(btn, currentWeight == idx + 1) }
        styleToggle(btnGlassWhite, !isBlackGlass)
        styleToggle(btnGlassBlack, isBlackGlass)
        styleToggle(btnTextWhite, !isBlackText)
        styleToggle(btnTextBlack, isBlackText)
        styleToggle(btnPickWallpaper, useBlur)
        styleToggle(btnClearWallpaper, !useBlur)
    }

    private fun refreshPreview() {
        val d = resources.displayMetrics.density
        ivBg.setImageBitmap(WidgetHelper.createFrostedGlassBitmap(this, (280 * d).toInt(), (155 * d).toInt(), 20f * d, currentOpacity, isBlackGlass, currentCropY, currentCropX, useBlur, false))
        ivPhrase.setImageBitmap(WidgetHelper.createPhraseBitmap(WidgetHelper.getPhraseForToday(this), (260 * d).toInt(), (125 * d).toInt(), currentWeight, isBlackText))
        chronometer.setTextColor(if (isBlackText) Color.argb(210, 15, 23, 30) else Color.argb(215, 255, 255, 255))
    }

    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)
        if (requestCode == 1001 && resultCode == Activity.RESULT_OK) {
            val uri: Uri? = data?.data
            if (uri != null && WidgetHelper.saveCustomWallpaperFromUri(this, uri)) {
                useBlur = true
                updateButtonsUI()
                Toast.makeText(this, "Fondo aplicado al cristal borroso", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                refreshPreview()
            }
        }
    }
}
